title: The Stones of the Vale
kicker: Tall carved stones with mossy grooves and offerings that are always fresh, where the light lingers a half-second too long in the gaps...
hook: Tall carved stones with mossy grooves and offerings that are always fresh, where the light lingers a half-second too long in the gaps between them.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: The Stones of the Vale glow blue at the edges, as if old protection is waking up angry and tired.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: Tall carved stones frame the approach, their grooves worn soft and packed with moss. Small offerings sit in a hollow between them, fresh, which means someone still comes. Light catches wrong in the gap between two of the stones and lingers a half-second too...

blocks.label: What Is Here
blocks.body: Local residents or workers appropriate to the place crickets, small birds, patient pollinators, lizards warming on stone No default combatant; add only if the scene introduces one Local civic, trade, or route interests Food, tools, route signs, local goods...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: No one trades here. People leave food rather than eat it, a heel of bread, a comb of honey, a cup of something poured straight onto the ground for whatever is listening.

affordances: Look for the busiest local gathering point.
Ask what has changed here recently.
